issues.where: upper right, between the limb and the sun (crops C, L)
issues.what: a thin, straight horizontal lens streak with an even width runs from the limb into the sun's corona; it reads as a pasted flare layer, not optics
issues.fix: remove the streak, or replace it with a faint anamorphic flare that is centred on the sun and fades out softly at both ends

issues.where: upper right near the sun (crops C, M)
issues.what: the same hard horizontal streak cuts across the limb glow, with a thin reddish arc beside it; both look like overlay artefacts and leave doubled edges on the corona
issues.fix: remove the streak and the stray arc, or blend the prominence into the solar limb

issues.what: the photosphere is blown out to a flat cream colour, with soft airbrushed mottling and no granulation; at native size it looks plastic
issues.fix: bring back the highlight detail in the sun, add fine granulation and limb darkening, and keep the bloom outside the disc

issues.where: dayside ray craters (crops A, L, Q)
issues.what: the bright ray craters end in starburst sparkles that look like specular glints stamped on the surface, and the same pattern repeats at several craters
issues.fix: tone down the glint at the centre of each crater and vary the ray patterns, so they read as surface albedo, not light sparkle

issues.where: lower left, dark limb against the sky (crop T); image-05 crop D
issues.what: a faint teal fringe sits along the unlit limb, with a hard diagonal edge, like a halo around a layer
issues.fix: remove the colour fringe at the dark limb, or soften its falloff

issues.what: faint vertical column banding shows in the near-black sky
issues.fix: add dither or fine grain to the dark gradients, so the banding breaks up

issues.where: lower left (crop D); image-05 crop O
issues.what: a small comet-like blob with a soft, smeared shape and no tail structure looks like a stray object
issues.fix: remove it, or render it as a proper comet with a tail that points away from the sun

issues.where: lower-left mid-latitudes and western terminator (image-14 crops D, F, H; image-15 crops N, O)
issues.what: craters and regolith texture are smeared and stretched into parallel diagonal streaks
issues.fix: reproject or re-author the spherical surface map and displacement without directional UV shear or motion-like smearing

issues.where: sunlit globe surface (image-14 crops B, F, G, I; image-15 crops J, K)
issues.what: surface albedo and crater detail are soft, blurry, and visibly upscaled at native pixel size
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution planetary texture and micro-normal detail so craters and ejecta rays stay crisp at 1:1 crop scale

issues.where: upper-right sky and Milky Way band (image-10 crop C; image-11 crops K, L, M)
issues.what: brighter stars sit inside distinct dark circular punch-out halos that carve black moats out of the background sky glow and nebula dust
issues.fix: composite stars additively without unsharp-mask or deconvolution ringing so background nebula brightness is preserved around point sources

issues.where: left and lower-left regolith and mid-ground crater shadows (image-10 crops B, D, G; image-11 crops K, O, P; image-12 crops T, U)
issues.what: hundreds of isolated 1-3 px orange, pink, yellow, and cyan specular fireflies sparkle across matte rock, and stray bright glowing dots with dark halos appear inside deep crater shadows
issues.fix: clamp sub-pixel specular fireflies, remove chromatic hot-pixel noise on rough regolith, and eliminate stray emissive points inside unlit shadows

issues.where: mid-ground bright double ray feature left of center (image-10 crop B; image-11 crop K)
issues.what: the right ray crater renders as stiff wire-like white spikes protruding from a dark pit beside an airbrushed white smudge
issues.fix: replace geometric spike strands and painted smudges with grounded surface-hugging high-albedo ejecta streaks integrated into the terrain displacement

issues.where: lower-right near foreground and steep right crater wall (image-10 crop F; image-12 crops W, X)
issues.what: near-foreground rock goes blurry with slight chromatic fringing, and steep inner crater scarps show vertical texture stretching
issues.fix: keep foreground depth-of-field sharp with higher-texel-density triplanar rock detail on steep walls and near-camera surfaces

issues.where: entire sunlit horizon limb (image-10 crops B, C; image-11 crops J, K, L)
issues.what: a 1-2 px warm orange-amber fringe runs along the airless horizon edge beneath a grainy flare haze
issues.fix: render a clean anti-aliased geometric limb against space without chromatic rim fringing

issues.where: sunlit upper/left limb and unlit lower nightside limb (image-14 crops B, G, H, I; image-16 crops S, T, U)
issues.what: the sunlit limb shows stair-stepped pixel aliasing with a faint warm outer halo and inner doubled rim, while the unlit nightside has a faint bluish-grey glowing rim against black space
issues.fix: supersample the globe silhouette for clean anti-aliasing, remove atmospheric-style rim halos on the airless body, and keep the unlit nightside limb true black
